clips.title: Two agents, one task
clips.caption: Type the task once, pick claude and codex, and each starts in its own worktree with the task as its first prompt.

clips.title: The pane that needs you
clips.caption: claude asks before editing; the dot and the All panes board say so until you answer, then it finishes.

clips.title: Stage, commit, push, review
clips.caption: Changed files, the patch, one hunk staged, a commit from the panel, a push, and the link to open the review.

clips.title: Quit, relaunch, carry on
clips.caption: Panes come back with their names, scrollback and a resumed badge, and claude still knows what it changed.

clips.title: Every pane at a glance
clips.caption: Five worktrees in the sidebar, the All panes board by what needs you, and ⌘K to jump between them.
